HELMET_COOP: Value of the Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy header; an empty value sends no header.
HELMET_CORP: Value of the Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy header; unset sends no header.
HELMET_CSP: JSON policy array merged over the default CSP per directive; empty or invalid JSON keeps the default.
HELMET_CSP_REPORT_ONLY: true sends the policy as Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only, observing violations without blocking them.
HELMET_CSP_REPORT_URI: URL browsers POST CSP violation reports to; adds report-uri and report-to to the policy plus a Reporting-Endpoints header. Must be https.
HELMET_CSP_TRUSTED_TYPES_ENABLED: true appends Trusted Types directives to the report-only CSP header.
HELMET_CSP_TRUSTED_TYPES_POLICIES: Comma-separated Trusted Types policy names; replaces the default list.
HELMET_CSRF_ALLOW_SAME_SITE: true lets Sec-Fetch-Site: same-site pass; off by default because sibling subdomains are still same-site.
HELMET_CSRF_ENABLED: true turns on the request-forgery guard for state-changing requests.
HELMET_CSRF_EXCEPT: Comma-separated path patterns that skip the guard: an exact path, a prefix ending in *, or * for every path.
HELMET_CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS: Comma-separated origins allowed to make state-changing requests when the Origin fallback is used.
HELMET_DEV_ORIGIN: Vite dev server origin, used in local only while the dev server is running; must be http or https on localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1]. Overrides the hot file.
HELMET_HSTS_INCLUDE_SUBDOMAINS: false omits the HSTS includeSubDomains directive.
HELMET_HSTS_MAX_AGE: HSTS max-age in seconds, sent on HTTPS only; must not be negative.
HELMET_HSTS_PRELOAD: true appends preload to HSTS; requires a year of max-age and includeSubDomains, and is hard to undo.
HELMET_METRICS_ALLOW: Comma-separated IPs or CIDR ranges allowed to scrape /metrics without a token.
HELMET_METRICS_ENABLED: true exposes the /metrics endpoint; with neither a token nor an allow list it returns 404 and logs a warning.
HELMET_METRICS_TOKEN: Bearer token the scraper sends as Authorization: Bearer <token>; compared with hash_equals.
HELMET_NO_STORE_ENABLED: true sends Cache-Control: no-store on matching responses.
HELMET_NO_STORE_PATHS: Comma-separated path prefixes that carry no-store; empty means every response.
HELMET_PERMISSIONS_POLICY: JSON feature map for the Permissions-Policy header; the default is a deny list and an empty object sends no header.
HELMET_POLICY_PATH: Path to a CREED policy.json; the ribbon then shows a version warning for the running PHP (and, in Laravel, framework) version. A missing or invalid file never breaks the page.
HELMET_PRESET: Platform preset name (citadel or docker) that supplies the trusted proxies; read from the environment, else from Playbook. HELMET_PROXIES wins when both are set; an unknown name throws.
HELMET_PROXIES: Comma-separated IPs or CIDR ranges allowed to set X-Forwarded-Proto; wins over HELMET_PRESET and is copied to trustedproxy.proxies when the app has not set it. An explicitly empty value trusts nobody.
HELMET_RIBBON: false switches the maintenance ribbon off everywhere.
HELMET_SCOPE: global puts SecurityHeaders in the kernel's global middleware; web keeps it in the web group only. InjectRibbon always stays in web.
HELMET_SESSION_SECURE: auto sets the Secure flag only when the request is HTTPS; always forces it for apps whose TLS terminates in a proxy. Anything else throws.
HELMET_WARN_DEBUG: true makes the Laravel adapter log one warning when the app boots with debug enabled in production.
